root_cause.grant_audit: Protected installed steward:camrui credential is ALLOW for resident.conversation.read and resident.conversation.send, exact scope office:office:grace.
root_cause.retry_behavior: Conversation history was not polled by the five-second dashboard status timer. Requests were navigation/refresh/send triggered. UI now pauses further protected requests after 403 until explicit reconnect.
root_cause.verified: The deployed browser contract kept the conversation authority credential only in page memory, and the password field explicitly used autocomplete=off. Refresh/release reload therefore did not restore the credential. The supplied 403 snapshot proves the browser request was denied by the exact-grant path; the actual Windows-presented credential was not captured or inspected.
